q: What did Caleb give to Othniel?
a: Caleb gave Achsah, his daughter, to be Othniel’s wife.
The judges saved the people of Israel from the power of those who were stealing their possessions.

q: Why did Sisera go to the tent of Jael?
a: Sisera went to the tent of Jael because there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor, and the house of Heber, Jael’s husband.

q: Why did Yahweh have the fearful soldiers return?
a: Yahweh had the fearful soldiers return so that Israel could not boast against Yahweh saying that their own power had saved them.

q: What wonderful thing did Yahweh do while Manoah and his wife were watching?
a: While Manoah and his wife were watching, the angel of Yahweh went up in the flame of the altar.

q: Why did Samson want his parents to get him the woman in Timnah as his wife?
a: He wanted his parents to get him the woman in Timnah as his wife, for when he looked at her, she pleased him.

q: What would happen to Samson’s wife if she did not entice her husband to get the answer to the riddle?
a: If Samson’s wife did not entice her husband to get the answer to the riddle, the 30 companions would burn up her and her father’s house.

q: For how long did Samson’s wife cry in order to get the answer to the riddle?
a: She cried for the seven days that the feast lasted.

q: How did Samson retaliate after finding out his wife had been given to another?
a: Samson retaliated by catching 300 foxes, tying torches to them, and letting them go in the Philistines’ grain.

q: Why did Samson kill a great number of Philistines?
a: Samson killed a great number of Philistines to avenge the killing of his wife and her father.

q: What did the five men from Dan want to do with the land of Laish?
a: The five men from Dan wanted to take possession of the land so their people could live there.
